# RPC grid, same-machine run: every cell and framed twin

CONTAINER INSTRUMENTATION, not a result (README 1.1). One `gen/rpc_same_machine.sh` run, no comparison with any other run. Per call: client process CPU (or wall) of a criterion sample divided by the calls in it, in **microseconds**; each entry is the median over the samples with [min-max]. `k` = calls in flight. The full client (cells in drop and retain) and the no-unknown client (`-nounk` cells, and its own A, B, Bf) are separate processes; so are the three direction groups (a/a+read/b, c, d) of each (transport, client); every cell of one direction shares a process. `f` = the framed send path (labelled extra cells), under its reference twin. **`*`** = one batch per sample (criterion's floor: the measurement time was shorter than 10 samples x 2 batches of that entry). Source: `summary-rpc.tsv` (ns).

    # rust slice RPC grid only (gen/rpc_same_machine.sh), for a side-by-side on the same machine
    # CONTAINER INSTRUMENTATION: not a campaign result; no gate run for this tree (coordinator: no code change, no gate)
    # commit     6f4c266b
    # date       2026-09-28T13:37:19Z
    # machine    Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz; 4 CPUs online; kernel 6.18.44-fc-v37
    # smt        active=0 control=notsupported
    # governor   n/a
    # cgroup     cpuset.cpus.effective=n/a
    # cpu sets   CLIENT=1 (taskset) SERVER=2,3 (taskset, serve.sh) OS=the rest
    # server     serve.sh (poc/rust/SERVER.md): ONE rpc_server process, tokio 4 workers, both sockets (shipped, pinned); serve.sh warm 50 (checked calls per direction a, b, c, d/4 from a tonic and a core client on each socket) before the first client process
    # client     benches/rpc_suite.rs, criterion 0.5 with the process-CPU measurement, SamplingMode::Flat; AK_SAMPLES=10 AK_WARMUP_MS=30 AK_NRESAMPLES=1000 (criterion's console bootstrap only; the samples are raw) AK_RPC_SERVER_WARMUP=0 AK_RPC_INFLIGHT=1,8; AK_MEASURE_MS per direction group: G1 (a, a+read, b) 250, G2 (c: P5.3, P5.4) 250, G3 (d: 4 MiB, 16 MiB) 500; one criterion iteration = one batch of k calls; per call = sample CPU (or wall) / (batches x k)
    # threads    client: tokio 2 workers per A/D/F cell runtime, ak_runtime_new(2) per B/C/E core client, k caller threads (B/C/E) or tasks (A/D/F)
    # order      per transport (shipped, pinned): full client G1, G2, G3, then no-unknown client G1, G2, G3; inside a process criterion's benchmarks in the seeded random order of AK_LAUNCH=1
    # runtime    rustc 1.94.1 (e408947bf 2026-03-25); cargo 1.94.1 (29ea6fb6a 2026-03-24)
    # incumbent  prost 0.14.4, tonic 0.14.6; criterion 0.5.1
    # build      cargo --release (opt-level 3, lto off), ak-core cdylib; full: rpc,init-guard,unknown-fields (target/); no-unknown: rpc,init-guard (target-nounk/); build time 1 s (not in the run time)

Entries: 840; samples per entry 10-10; batches per sample 1-26; entries with ONE batch per sample: 311 (a k=8, a+read k=8, b k=8, c/P5.3 k=8, c/P5.4 k=8, d/16MiB k=1, d/16MiB k=8, d/4MiB k=8).
